activity_summary: At home the Candlemas packet was still on the desk. You did not write a price for the gown, because you had not been told one.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the desk and went no further.

entities.name: the Candlemas letter
entities.context: Mentioned in Still on the desk

facets.activity: Left the packet on the desk

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The packet is where I left it. Thursday.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not write a sum I have not heard.
